permission-owner.name: Users
permission-owner.desc: Permissions controlling uPortal user account management

activity.name: Edit user attribute
activity.desc: Edit a specific user attribute. This permission applies to that attribute for all editable users

activity.name: Impersonate users
activity.desc: Impersonate users for debugging purposes in uPortal

activity.name: View own attribute
activity.desc: View one's own value(s) for the specified user attribute. This permission is cumulative with VIEW_USER_ATTRIBUTE

activity.name: View user attribute
activity.desc: View a specific user attribute. This permission applies to that attribute for all visible users
